== Official partial-slip source ==
The source is the unchanged official Set 7 PDF, printed edition September 2023, page 2. PDF SHA-256 <code>597c96306746c8958d56283651afdf714ff23b88e847e86bbc39e319c578e363</code>. Image xref10 SHA-256 <code>17e17bc978a3fcfc5b77d85caf3ada9e45086378a02e77c8bab65d265bd0611d</code>; original mask xref9 stream SHA-256 <code>7516c43f556f5b69ccaf94e083534b058424c577734b3ebff8686ac81145ed74</code>. The embedded panel is 745×338 and intentionally omits the upper face. No image was repainted or completed.

The existing current full image is evidenced in Holotable by 4 November 2022; the documented sheet edition is September 2023. This orders the source editions used in the draft, not an asserted first publication day for the partial layout. A bounded 2022–2024  CDX query returned an empty list; the official 2017 design announcement proves the card’s earlier release but not this particular image edition. PDF metadata does not establish the publication date.

Existing supported family <code>207_3</code> is preserved. No new executable ID or Card redirect is created. Article numbering follows the existing visible-version family pattern; the source’s actual printed errata mark is recorded separately.
